function: Learned joint control of UAV 3D trajectory, downlink transmit power, NOMA power allocation and IoT node association to maximize energy efficiency and Jain fairness (p. 1-3).
system: One rotary-wing UAV, single omnidirectional antenna, serves 20 IoT nodes by downlink PD-NOMA, 2 per slot; no RIS; 1.75 kHz bandwidth, carrier not stated (p. 2, 4).
method: PPO deep reinforcement learning with six simultaneous discrete actions; policy and value neural networks (Table I); trained online by interaction with the simulated environment (p. 2-4).
data_channel: Own simulator: gain h = rho d^-2 with rho = 1; 20 IoT nodes uniform in a 100x100 m area; no dataset (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Same setting for training and evaluation: curves are per training episode (up to 5000) with 20 random nodes; no separate test scenario (p. 4-5, Figs. 1-2).
baselines: Non-learned HDF [13] (fuzzy power control, circular trajectory, random association); own variants Proposed-PA (PA of [12]) and other lambda_I; no earlier learned method (p. 4-5, Fig. 2).
metrics: Energy efficiency (bits/Joule), sum rate, spectral efficiency, Jain fairness index and reward versus training episode (p. 4-5, Figs. 1-2).
complexity: Order of complexity of Algorithm 1: C1 = O(eps_max/T x (T N e log(e) + E)), with Tim sort cost e log(e) (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "reference distance d0 = 1m [9], [14]" for the gain h = rho d^-2, a distance-only path loss of the authors' own simulator (p. 4: 20 random nodes). No 3GPP or other standardized model, dataset or measurement is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "All configurations are executed using the same system parameters." Fig. 1 varies training hyper-parameters (learning rate, epsilon, lambda_I), not test scenarios; no unseen scenario, node count or adaptation is reported.
q3_support: p. 4: "three different schemes: 1) Proposed: the proposed framework;" 2) Proposed-PA, its own variant with the PA of [12], and 3) HDF [13], rule-based (p. 5: "fuzzy inference system to choose"). No earlier learned method is compared; PPO is only argued against DQN (p. 2), with no results.
q4_support: p. 4: "The computational complexity of Algorithm 1 is calculated as:" C1 = O((eps_max/T) x (T x N x (e log(e)) + E)), depending on episodes, trajectories, locations, Tim sort cost and epochs.
q5_support: p. 4: "nodes are randomly and uniformly distributed. Our simulation" shows the data come from the authors' own simulator. No code or data link, and no public or measured dataset, is mentioned.
notes: Included, area 6: the PPO agent controls UAV trajectory and node association (above the physical layer) jointly with downlink transmit power and NOMA power allocation, which are physical-layer decisions for an aerial link, so above_phy does not apply (p. 1-3). A single-antenna link is admitted for area 6. HDF [13] is read as non-learned from its fuzzy rules (p. 5). Table I and the complexity formula were read from the page image (p. 4).
